description: What counts as a secret in a name or a value, for every place that must never store one: remediation event detail (config/js/remediation_contract.js, service/platform/remediation.py, native/market_runtime/src/remediation.rs) and saved config revisions (config/config_revisions.py, config/js/config_revisions.js). Each language implements the same rules over this data (AGENTS.md section 2: data shared, no shared helper: config/secret_scrub.py, config/js/secret_scrub.js, the scrub module of remediation.rs); tests/fixtures/secret_scrub_cases.json holds the cases all three must agree on. Spaces are ' ' and tab; whitespace is those plus CR, LF, FF and VT; a NAME CHARACTER is A-Z a-z 0-9 _ . -; a VALUE RUN is one or more characters that are neither whitespace nor one of " ' & ; , ( ) [ ] { } < > (so an already redacted value is never a value run again). A NAME is secret when, upper-cased with every character outside A-Z and 0-9 removed, it contains one of key_markers or equals one of exact_names. A STRING VALUE carries a secret where: (1) a maximal run of name characters that is a secret name is followed by an optional closing quote (" or '), optional spaces, '=' or ':', optional spaces, an optional opening quote and a value run (a URL query parameter, a form field, a header line, JSON quoted inside a message): that value run is the secret, except that when it is one of auth_schemes (any case) the scheme stays and the secret is the value run after the spaces that follow it, if any; (2) one of bare_schemes (any case, not preceded by a letter or digit) is followed by spaces and a value run: that run; (3) a JSON Web Token: 'eyJ' not preceded by A-Z a-z 0-9 _ -, then one or more of A-Z a-z 0-9 _ -, '.', one or more of those, '.', and any number of those: the whole token; (4) the text contains pem_marker: the whole string. Overlapping spans merge; a scrubbed string has each span replaced by `redacted`; a config revision holding any is refused. Structures are walked to max_depth levels; deeper content is replaced by `redacted` whole.
